citations.F1: N+1 query problem: serialize_event does one fetchrow per event, so 1000 individual actor queries per request.
citations.F3: requests.get() in lookup_geo is synchronous, blocking the worker on cache misses (2 s timeout), causing /healthz to hang.
citations.F4: Add `CREATE INDEX events_org_created_idx ON events (org_id, created_at DESC)`.
citations.F5: Unbounded _geo_cache and _request_timings grow indefinitely ... bound _request_timings similarly.
citations.F6: Bound _geo_cache to ~10k entries with LRU eviction
citations.F9: **Do NOT ship the on-call proposal**: scaling workers and pools won't fix the root cause (missing index, N+1 queries); Redis cache is premature band-aid; fix index and N+1 first
